  [Biotechnology]
  LIFS | Any LIFS courses at 3000/4000-level
  [Business]

caveats: Students with level 3 or above in HKDSE 1x Biology are exempted from taking LIFS 1901 -- an exemption, not a requirement; it is not applied automatically.
Students with level 3 or above in HKDSE 1/2x or 1x Chemistry are exempted from taking CHEM 1008 -- an exemption, not a requirement; it is not applied automatically.

Biotechnology and Business Electives (Courses from the specified elective list, of which at least 3 credits from each area in Biotechnology / Business. Courses taken as Major Required Courses may not be counted towards this elective requirement.) -- the credits and the course count are checked, but the extra condition in this sentence is not. Confirm it with your advisor.
Requirements: COMP 1022P is named in the requirement PDF but not in the 2026-27 course catalog, so it was left out of this check.
